title: Aerobic granular sludge as a regenerative system for nutrient removal and metal recovery from landfill leachate
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1121-1133
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05817A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Víctor Guzmán-Fierro, Manuel Quiroz, Karla Moscoso, Constanza Arriagada, Carlo Espinoza, Javiera Mansilla, David Contreras, Víctor Campos, Juan José Gallardo-Rodríguez, Gustavo Riveros, Marlene Roeckel
AGS effectively treated raw landfill leachate, achieving 94% COD and 97% N removal. Desorption enabled metal recovery without compromising granule structure or function. AGS demonstrated a dual role in leachate treatment and resource recovery.
